honing_confound: Wild Instincts (Ferality) damage scales across three meters simultaneously. Paralysis immunity and push immunity are combat survivability buffs, not damage scaling. Primary damage stat is Specialization (per nexus guide same stat allocation as PBA). T4 Specialization boosts Bear and Fox skill damage. Three-meter complexity means confound operates across all three resource systems simultaneously.

delivery.evidence: Wildsoul physically transforms into Bear or Fox form for damage skills. Bear Form: heavy slam and claw attacks at melee range. Fox Form: fast bite and claw attacks at melee range. The Wildsoul player IS the beast — self-transformation, not proxy summoning. Phantom Beast skills fill meter; Bear/Fox forms deliver damage.

footprint.evidence: Bear Form attacks: heavy melee AoE slam (small-radius cone/circle). Fox Form attacks: rapid small-radius strikes. Both forms are close-range melee. No wide-zone bombardment.

geo_text: Wild Instincts Wildsoul manages THREE meters: (1) Phantom Beast Energy (center orb) — fills passively in human form; consumed to cast Bear and Fox skills. (2) Bear Energy (yellow) — fills via Bear skills and passively in Bear Form; when full: unlocks Ripping Bear (Z available in Bear Form). (3) Fox Energy (blue) — fills via Fox skills and passively in Fox Form; when full: unlocks Fox Star Rainstorm (Z available in Fox Form). FORM TRANSITIONS: Bear Form grants damage reduction and defensive utility; Fox Form grants attack speed buff. WILD INSTINCTS IDENTITY: burst-focused three-form management with paralysis immunity and push immunity — high defensive utility alongside DPS.

control.evidence: Bear Form skills have knockdown/knockback effects (heavy slam). Push immunity is defensive rather than offensive CC. Paralysis immunity enables continued action during normally-interrupting attacks.

defense.evidence: Wild Instincts is uniquely defensively capable: paralysis immunity (can continue acting through boss grip/paralysis attacks), push immunity (cannot be knocked back in Bear Form or via specific skills). Bear Form reduces incoming damage. This is one of the higher-defense melee DPS identities in LA.

economy.resource_verbatim: Phantom Beast Energy (center) + Bear Energy (yellow) + Fox Energy (blue)
economy.builder_source: Phantom Beast Energy: passively fills in human form, fills via Phantom Beast skills. Bear Energy: Bear skills + passive in Bear Form. Fox Energy: Fox skills + passive in Fox Form.
economy.plain_text: THREE-METER ECONOMY: Phantom Beast Energy consumed to cast Bear/Fox skills → Bear Form or Fox Form skills fill respective meters → Bear meter full: Ripping Bear (Z) unlocks → Fox meter full: Fox Star Rainstorm (Z) unlocks. Each form has its own identity skill unlocked by filling its specific meter. WILD INSTINCTS IDENTITY: burst-focused — the two Z-key unlocks are the burst peaks. High mana drain from constant form switching and skill use. Economy: cycle between Bear and Fox skills while managing all three meters simultaneously.

element.evidence: Wildsoul uses nature/beast energy. Bear and Fox forms deal Physical/Nature damage via claw, bite, and slam attacks.

movement.evidence: Bear Form: slower but defensive. Fox Form: faster attack speed. Push immunity prevents movement interruption. Overall: good mobility relative to defensive utility.

attr.evidence: Pure melee — both Bear and Fox forms attack at close range (0-5m). Human form (Phantom Beast skill casts) may have slightly longer reach.

range.evidence: All form attacks are melee range.

tempo.evidence: Wild Instincts is burst-focused: the three-meter system builds toward the Z-key unlocks (Ripping Bear or Fox Star Rainstorm) which are the burst moments. Building all three meters simultaneously is the pre-burst phase.

amp.value: Bear Form: damage reduction + paralysis immunity + push immunity; Fox Form: attack speed buff; Ripping Bear (Z in Bear): burst attack when Bear meter full; Fox Star Rainstorm (Z in Fox): burst attack when Fox meter full
amp.evidence: Nexus guide: 'Bear Energy: unlock Ripping Bear (Z-key), usable only in bear form. Fox Energy: unlock Fox Star Rainstorm (Z-key), usable only in fox form. Bear Form: Tanks damage and gains damage reduction. Fox Form: Increases attack speed.' Wild Instincts: 'Burst-focused with paralysis immunity and push immunity.'

proxy.evidence: Wild Instincts is self-transformation — the Wildsoul player BECOMES the bear or fox. Not a proxy summon. Compare with Phantom Beast Awakening where skills summon spirit entities.

commitment.evidence: Heavy Bear Form attacks have wind-up (slams, charges). Fox Form attacks are faster. Ripping Bear and Fox Star Rainstorm are the charged burst skills with significant wind-up animation.

mechanics_notes: 1) THREE-METER COMPLEXITY: Wild Instincts is LA's most complex meter economy. Managing Phantom Beast Energy (fuel for form entry), Bear Energy (fills in Bear form), and Fox Energy (fills in Fox form) simultaneously while tracking which Z-key unlock is available creates the highest identity management demand in the Specialist archetype. 2) DEFENSIVE IDENTITY ON A DPS: paralysis immunity + push immunity + Bear Form damage reduction makes Wild Instincts one of the most survivable melee DPS identities. Unusual for a DPS identity to provide this level of defensive utility. 3) HIGH MANA DRAIN is the stated weakness: constant form switching and skill use in Wild Instincts is mana-intensive. The class requires mana management (atypical for LA DPS classes which rarely need to track mana). 4) WILDSOUL RELEASE (Feb 2025) makes it a native Ark Passive class: legacy_engraving_system=false. The identity paths were designed for the Enlightenment tree from launch. 5) Ripping Bear and Fox Star Rainstorm — both Z-key unlocks — represent a unique design: the same button (Z) does different things in different forms, depending on which meter is full.
stabilization_patch: Wild Instincts favored by players who want the defensive utility and complexity; Phantom Beast Awakening for players who want simpler uptime-based gameplay.

geo_text: Phantom Beast Awakening Wildsoul fills a dedicated Phantom Beast Awakening meter → Z activates Phantom Beast Awakening Form: +20% Attack Speed, +20% Movement Speed, lasts 30 seconds. mechanics_notes: 1) SPIRIT PROXY IN AWAKENING FORM: PBA is the only Wildsoul identity where skill delivery converts from self-transformation to spirit summoning. This is a mechanically distinct delivery mode — the Wildsoul doesn't become the bear/fox but summons phantom versions instead. Makes PBA the Specialist archetype's clearest proxy-delivery DPS identity. 2) EARLY EXIT (X-KEY) MECHANIC: exiting Awakening Form early via X auto-consumes all accumulated spirit stacks. This creates an optimization around the 'correct exit timing' — hold the form for maximum stack generation, but exit when stack-to-cooldown conversion is most valuable. Similar logic to Machinist's Evolutionary Legacy 40% Core refund optimization. 3) 100% CDR AT MAX STACKS: 20 stacks × 5% = effectively halved cooldowns at peak stack accumulation within the 30s window. This makes PBA's late-window output significantly faster than its early-window output. 4) PBA IS THE 'SIMPLER' WILDSOUL: one meter, no form-switching complexity, no paralysis/push immunity trade-offs. Compared to Wild Instincts' three-meter system, PBA is significantly more accessible. 5) NATIVE ARK PASSIVE (legacy_engraving_system=false): Wildsoul was designed for the Enlightenment tree from launch (Feb 2025). No legacy engraving system existed for this class.
